# QR generator

`qrcodegen.py` is the unmodified Python library from Project Nayuki's
[QR-Code-generator v1.8.0](https://github.com/nayuki/QR-Code-generator/tree/v1.8.0/python).

Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nayuki/QR-Code-generator/v1.8.0/python/qrcodegen.py

MIT license and copyright notice are retained in the source file. Used only to
generate local SVG join codes; requires no installed packages or network calls.
